page.overview:
What is Nan Elmoth?

Nan Elmoth was a forest in East Beleriand, east of Doriath, south of the River Celon, and just north of Estolad.

Its trees grew to be the tallest and darkest in Beleriand, blocking the Sun entirely from the forest floor.

It was in Nan Elmoth that Melian enchanted the Telerin Elf-king Elwë (later known as Thingol) before they founded the realm of Doriath together. The couple remained here for a while as their love grew, and young trees grew tall before they spoke. When Melian and Elwë left for Doriath, Nan Elmoth was held to be part of the kingdom of Doriath.

Eöl "the Dark Elf" paid Thingol with the sword Anglachel for permission to dwell in Nan Elmoth. He apparently lived in the forest for centuries, with only a few servants. The princess of Gondolin Aredhel Ar-Feiniel came to Eöl's dwelling, and they were eventually married. Maeglin was born to them there in FA 320.
